mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona City Hall with the temperature at 34 degrees and a New Moon phase tonight.

The City of Verona announced that pavement repairs are scheduled for Tuesday and Wednesday. Work includes milling and patching on Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, Mozart Street, Todd Street, Edward Street, and near Hemlock Drive at Mahogany Way. Expect parking restrictions from 7 AM to 7 PM both days.

Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is a busy day with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, and live music also at Paddy Mac's along with the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher deal at Lake Lou-ee.

Regarding recent activity, on October 25, Verona Police officers located a man passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which led to an arrest for an O W I charge.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Georgia Peach, which is the flavor of the day. The Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
